summary: Unidentified man found deceased in a tent at a backcountry campsite on the west side of Rocky Mountain National Park; rangers and Grand County SAR wheeled the body out Sunday morning and transferred it to the Grand County Coroner
location: backcountry campsite, west side, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: Body found Saturday night 2015-10-10; recovered Sunday 2015-10-11. Identity and cause of death unknown at publication; west-side thin-year fill (run 720).
